title: SB LX, halftime show fall shy of ratings records

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: SB LX, halftime show fall shy of ratings records
sources.description: Seattle's 29-13 victory over New England in Super Bowl LX averaged 124.9 million viewers, while Bad Bunny's halftime show averaged 128.2 million, both falling short of setting records for most-watched U.S. broadcast and halftime show.
